brief.audience: People who enjoy a calm, intentional daily skincare routine.
brief.promise: A natural-feeling soap ritual that brings simplicity and quiet to the start of the day.
brief.setting: Minimal, serene bathroom sink with natural materials and subtle botanical accents.
brief.lighting: Soft diffused morning light, warm neutral tones, gentle highlights on water and foam.
brief.cameraMotion: Slow macro push-ins, smooth lateral slides and steady close-up tracking.
brief.pacing: Unhurried cuts every 3–5 seconds, synchronized with each narration phrase.

scenes.purpose: Open on a tactile bar beside botanicals, establishing a calm everyday ritual.
scenes.motion: Slow push-in across the bar’s surface.

scenes.purpose: Show hands lifting the fresh bar and wetting it beneath a gentle stream.
scenes.motion: Steady side track following the hands.

scenes.purpose: Highlight creamy texture as the bar builds soft foam between palms.
scenes.motion: Subtle orbit around the lathering action.

scenes.purpose: Create a quiet pause with rinsing hands, droplets and a peaceful sink setting.
scenes.motion: Locked frame with natural hand and water movement.

scenes.purpose: End with the bar resting beside linen and botanicals, suggesting a simple morning beginning.
scenes.motion: Slow pull-back to reveal the serene arrangement.
